root_text: What is Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV)? Discovered in 2001, HMPV is a respiratory virus causing cold/flu-like symptoms. While most cases are mild, it can lead to severe illnesses like bronchitis or pneumonia in vulnerable groups. #HMPV #Healt
